profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at PerByte, Inc
profile.summary: I have been a developer for many years and have a passion for doing it.  I like to make software that benefits others and makes their lives easier.  My goal is to write quality software that the user finds easy to use and understand and all the while providing the company with all the required information and helping them to grow.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Develop web solutions using C#, Javascript, JQuery, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3 and other various technologies.  Develop several plugins and custom code for several company's using the Aptify AMS system.

positions.title: Application Developer Lvl 4
positions.description: Maintained thousands of servers ensuring that they were always online and available.  Deployed custom in-house applications do these servers on a regular basis.  Helped to upgrade server systems from Server 2003 to Server 2012.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I write code used by the Navy.  I work on fixing bugs and creating new functionality in their main product.  I have also worked on a project using NASA's WorldWind software and integrating them with the Oculus Rift goggles using a .Net interface but primarily written in Java.

positions.title: Web Developer / DBA
positions.description: I helped to maintain the company's website, as well as build several plugins to the main AMS system.  I also helped to create new products and services available to users on the web.  I maintained the company's many databases to provide the most efficient data access and maintain proper backup's.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description: Design and develop web based applications. Update the existing site with new look and functionality using CSS3 and JQuery.  Upgrade and maintain ISS.

positions.title: .Net Application/Web Developer
positions.description: I develop .Net Winforms and Web based applications that integrate with AS/400 - DB2, SQL Server and Access databases.

positions.title: Systems Administrator / Developer
positions.description: Developed WinForm and Web based applications for the company's Intranet

positions.title: Web Developer / Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Developed several in-house applications to increase and streamline productivity using VB.Net and ASP.Net.  Applications include a customer concern log to track customer concerns, an MRB log to track material reviews, a part test tracker to track part testing and many more.  Wrote detailed documentation on all applications to help end users.  Designed database and table structures that were used for storing data from in-house applications.  Created a time clock system from the ground up which included clock-in module for kiosk workstations, manager application for supervisors and managers to correct mistakes, holiday/sick/vacation/unpaid time off tracker, and reports (Web and Crystal XI) used to track and report employee work hours and time off.  Helped users transition into a new ERP system, JD Edwards, from the old system Vantage.  Developed several small applications to integrated with the JD Edwards database (DB2) and pull data to generate labels on UPS Worldship, Fedex Ship Manager and Bartender label software.

Sole IT person for a company with over 100 employees.  Managed 6 Windows 2000/2003 servers, which included making sure all the latest updates were applied and that all data was backed up.  Made certain that company network, including Wi-Fi, and servers were available 24/7.  Set up and maintained a Watchguard firewall to ensure internal security and prevent users from visiting unwanted sites and hardened security settings on the firewall to all for VPN connections.  Set up user accounts and profiles in Active Directory, Exchange and SQL Server.    Ensured all servers and workstations had the latest virus protection including the Exchange server with GFI mail security scanner.  Migrated all user workstations from Windows 2000 to Windows XP.  Maintained Norton Ghost images of all workstations and servers.  Redesigned backup strategies to ensure data integrity and reliability.  Thoroughly documented all procedures in case they needed to be performed again
